description: VFX / gosFX rendering variants: GPU particle batcher gate plus the Track-V VFX-payoff stack (soft particles, lit particles, bloom participation). All payoff gates are default-OFF; entries below opt them in for capture.

entries.description: Default VFX settings (MC2_GPU_PARTICLES default-ON, gosFX CPU sim active, all payoff gates OFF). Byte-identical baseline.
GPU particle kill switch (MC2_GPU_PARTICLES=0): accepted Card/CardCloud draws are suppressed; no CPU fallback.

VFX-SOFT-PARTICLES-MVP-1: depth-fade alpha particles at scene intersections (options.cfg VfxSoftParticles=1, passed as MC2_OPTIONS_OVERRIDE). Look for soft smoke/dust where it meets terrain/mechs instead of hard billboard edges.
VFX-LIT-PARTICLES-MVP-1: scene-lit alpha smoke/dust (options.cfg VfxLitParticles=1, passed as MC2_OPTIONS_OVERRIDE). Smoke should take on the mission sun/ambient tint; additive flashes unchanged.
Full VFX-payoff stack: soft + lit particles.
VFX-DEBUG-VIEWS-1 ParticleKind view (MC2_VFX_DEBUG_MODE=3): distinct color per particle kind. Diagnostic-only.
VFX-DEBUG-VIEWS-1 Overdraw view (MC2_VFX_DEBUG_MODE=4): additive proxy reveals particle blend buildup. Diagnostic-only.
Default Card/CardCloud GPU draws with particle logging; Tube/Shape classes retain CPU MLR rendering.
